steps.agent_response:
Yes — I can help. I’ll start with a short plan and a few quick questions so I prepare exactly what you need.

Quick questions
- Is the session remote (Zoom/Teams) or in-person? If remote, do you want me to create a meeting link?
- How long is the training scheduled to be (30 / 45 / 60 / 90 minutes or other)?
- What’s the training topic and the primary learning objectives?
- Who will attend (just Mr. Chen + you, or a group)? About how many people?
- Do you already have materials (slides, handouts, exercises, spreadsheet) to use, or should I draft them from scratch?
- Do you want me to confirm the session with Mr. Chen by email now, save a draft, or just prepare materials?

Suggested preparation plan (I can execute any items you pick)
1) Confirm + logistics (I can draft/send an email to Mr. Chen or search your inbox for the thread)
   - Confirm time/date/duration, location or video link, and attendee list
   - Ask if he wants any specific topics, required pre-work, or files attached

2) Agenda (example for a 60-minute session)
   - 0–5 min: Welcome, objectives & agenda
   - 5–20 min: Topic overview / policy background
   - 20–40 min: Demonstration / walkthrough / hands-on exercise
   - 40–50 min: Q&A and clarifications
   - 50–60 min: Next steps, actions, and feedback

3) Materials to prepare
   - Slide deck (6–12 slides): objectives, key points, screenshots/demos, exercises, resources
   - One-page handout or checklist for attendees
   - Short pre-read (if needed)
   - Quick feedback form (1–5 questions)

4) Slide deck outline (sample)
   - Title slide: session title, date, presenter(s)
   - Objectives slide: 2–3 measurable outcomes
   - Background/context slide: why this matters
   - Main content slides: process / steps / examples (2–4 slides)
   - Demo / exercise slide: instructions and expected results
   - FAQs / common issues slide
   - Next steps & resources slide
   - Feedback & contact slide

5) Logistics checklist (to verify 24–48 hours before)
   - Room booked or meeting link created and tested
   - A/V check (microphone, screen sharing, projector)
   - Materials uploaded/shared with attendees
   - Calendar invite + reminder(s) sent
   - Backup plan if connection or tech fails

   - By 5 business days before: finalize agenda & request any input from Mr. Chen
   - By 3 business days before: finish slides & handouts
   - 1 business day before: final rehearsal and tech check; send reminder with link/attachments
